Who We Are

Built for Speed.
Driven by Passion.

2026
Founded
4
Series
12
Countries
64+
Drivers

Velocity Motorsport Series is a premier motorsport organisation dedicated to discovering, developing, and showcasing the next generation of world-class drivers. VMS operates four championships — from Formula 3 through to our flagship F1, plus a full Endurance ladder spanning GT3, LMP2, and Hypercar.

Founded in 2026 on the belief that motorsport should be accessible, competitive, and spectacular, we provide the infrastructure, technical excellence, and competitive environment that turns raw talent into champions.

Our Mission

To build the world's most competitive and respected formula and endurance racing ecosystem — one that gives every talented driver, regardless of background, a genuine pathway to the pinnacle of the sport.
